5.1.5. Control variables
The choice task was followed by the PANAS (Watson et al., 1988) to
control for a potential eﬀect of our manipulation on mood. Participants
were also asked to report their year of birth.

(α = 0.70) was 5.17 in the limited FTP condition (SD = 0.74), 5.52 in
the control condition (SD = 0.73), and 5.54 in the expansive FTP
condition (SD = 0.79). An ANOVA conﬁrmed a signiﬁcant diﬀerence
